Fractions

Learn equal parts of a whole.

Understand the idea first

A fraction describes equal parts of one whole or equal parts of a group.

Equal parts first

The pieces must be equal. Cutting a pizza into unequal pieces does not make fair halves.

Top number

The numerator tells how many equal parts we are talking about.

Bottom number

The denominator tells how many equal parts make one whole.

Example

1/2 means 1 of 2 equal parts. 1/4 means 1 of 4 equal parts. 2/4 is the same amount as 1/2.
